rationale: Builds on the current recurrent-tail baseline with a compact structural change instead of another scalar sweep. I added a learned per-tail-block anchor refresh gate, initialized near the old fixed-anchor behavior, so reverse-tail recurrence can gradually update its carry anchor only when training finds it useful. This targets the still-live anchor-refresh idea category while preserving compile stability, tail sharing, exact eval, and compressed size discipline.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Gate
